outcome: Share owned Experiments read-only with a specific researcher
owner_impact: An Experiment owner can explicitly share an owned Experiment read-only with an available registry researcher. Recipients see shared Experiments separately from My Experiments, can inspect/run them, and can copy an exact saved revision into their own workspace without gaining write access to the source.

next.text: The #45 collaboration epic continues with #290 — revoke sharing and preserve collaboration boundaries. That ticket will add share removal, prove that revoked access disappears while independent copies survive, and confirm Showcase and Professor-supervision access stay separate. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: experiment_shares is an RLS-protected permission table with recipient-only read access and owner-scoped share creation.
The Experiment SELECT boundary recognizes explicit recipients while existing Experiment mutation remains owner-only.
The copy-to-workspace path recognizes explicit shares so recipients can create independent owned copies.
